To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the USEPA's LoCs for atrazine were derived from an expanded set of cosm studies, and we developed a scoring system to weight the studies according to their relevance and reliability to derive the LoC.

(1) a total of 108 data points were extracted from 39 atrazine microcosm and microcosms studies, (2) the data points were scored for effects on plants, (3) the data points and scores were weighted for relevance and reliability, and (4) the weighted data were used to calculate a level of concern (LOC) of 21.1 µg/L for the 60 d PATI.
the current USEPA LoC of 20 μg/L for atrazine was derived using an unweighted database that included 108 effect scores from 39 atrazine cosm studies.
